restoration_note: All eight gaps are tightly constrained by line-break completions of standard Lycopolitan formulae. Apparatus proposals fit the spiritual arc: the pure soul (ⲧⲉⲧⲟⲩⲁⲁⲃⲉ) as second ploughed-field standing in the whole Zone (upper place / lower place), two exalted Luminaries — the Lord's operative farmers from above — tilling her so that, by likeness (ⲡⲟⲩⲉⲓⲛⲉ), she is drawn upward (ⲥⲱⲟ̄ⲉ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈) and goes forth (ϣⲁⲃⲁⲗ) into the Height. Each fill respects partial traces, character count, and the cross-segment continuation pattern characteristic of the Kephalaia's columnar layout.

coptic_restorations.basis: Lycopolitan doubled feminine ordinal article ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second (fem.)' modifying ⲱⲍⲉ 'ploughed-field'; standard pattern paralleled in ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ.
Completes ⲧⲉⲧⲟⲩⲁⲁⲃⲉ 'the holy (fem.)', standard feminine qualitative; the pure soul is the holy field — lexicon entry 'pure' (ⲟⲩⲁⲃⲉ) confirms register.
Completes ⲡⲥⲁⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'the lower place', the standard Lycopolitan compound, confirmed by -ⲧⲛⲉ at the start of line 4849; pairs with ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲧⲉ above.

Completes ⲙ̄ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ (Greek φωστήρ) 'Luminaries' — confirmed by -ⲥⲧⲏⲣ at the start of line 4850; in the reading, the two great Luminaries are the Lord's two exalted operations tilling the soul from above.
Completes ⲣ̄ⲓⲉⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲉ 'doing farmer's work' — verbal vowel of the compound; uncontracted form recurs elsewhere in the chapter.
Completes ⲥⲱⲟ̄ⲉ 'drawing' continued by -ⲟ̄ⲉ at the start of line 4852; the full phrase ⲥⲱⲟ̄ⲉ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'draw upward' matches the spiritual reading: the soul drawn upward by likeness.
Directional preposition ⲁ- 'to/unto' before ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲧⲉ 'the upper place', parallel to ⲁⲧⲡⲭⲓⲥⲉ 'unto the Height' immediately preceding.
Completes ϣⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth, manifestly, until forth' — the standard adverbial phrase marking the soul's going-forth into the upper place; lexical pattern with ⲟⲩⲁⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ etc.

english_restorations.basis: ⲧⲉⲧⲟⲩⲁⲁⲃⲉ 'the holy (fem.)' — the pure soul as the holy field; lexicon 'pure / defiled' supports 'holy' for ⲟⲩⲁⲃⲉ in this celestial register.
ⲡⲥⲁⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'the lower place' as the standard counterpart to ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲧⲉ 'the upper place'; lexicon entry 'high / low' confirms the rendering.

ⲙ̄ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ (φωστήρ) 'Luminaries'; the line-break completion -ⲥⲧⲏⲣ is folded into this English phrase so the next segment's English begins fresh — the two great farmers exalted over the field of the soul.

ⲥⲱⲟ̄ⲉ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'drawing upward'; the verb begun at the end of line 4851 (ⲥⲱ-) is naturally rendered once, here, where its completion -ⲟ̄ⲉ stands; matches the reading's image of the soul drawn upward by likeness.
Directional ⲁ- 'to/unto'; rendered 'unto' to harmonize with the preceding ⲁⲧⲡⲭⲓⲥⲉ 'unto the Height'.
ϣⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth, until-forth' — the soul going forth into the upper place; matches the spiritual reading: 'she goes forth into it.'
